lastCompletedStory.title: CRITICAL: US-003's dispatch-terminal cleanup is never wired into production.

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 closed the CRITICAL finding that US-003's removeCodexInstructionsFile (backend-adapter.ts:470) was exported but never called from production -- the only real callers were test/supervisor/codex-instructions-reap.test.ts's own AC6 test, which drove buildSpawnArgv then called the reaper ITSELF to simulate a terminal, so it verified rmSync, not the dispatch lifecycle. Root-caused across ALL FOUR actor terminals (not just the two the story's own text named): (1) worker-dispatch.ts's WorkerDispatchLifecycleOptions gained a required `agentName: string` field; its shared removeWorkerTaskPrompt chokepoint now calls removeCodexInstructionsFile(agentName, uuid) alongside the existing task-prompt-file removal, best-effort/idempotent (force:true rmSync no-ops on a claude-backend dispatch, which never wrote one). (2) loop.ts (implementer): added a `removeImplementerTaskPrompt` closure at the top of the implement branch that always threads DEFAULT_IMPLEMENTER_AGENT (loop.ts has no agentName override today, so this constant is always correct); replaced all 4 removeWorkerTaskPrompt(opts, uuid) call sites and added agentName to the 3 inline runVerifiedWorkerDispatch/runCheckedWorkerSentinel object literals. (3) review.ts (reviewer): reused the already-resolved local `agentName` const (opts.agentName ?? DEFAULT_REVIEWER_AGENT, resolved once near the top of makeReviewDispatch) at all 5 removeWorkerTaskPrompt call sites (via `{ ...opts, agentName }`, since opts.agentName itself may be undefined -- the resolved default must be threaded explicitly) and the 3 inline dispatch/sentinel object literals. (4) plan-runner.ts (planner + auditor): its own SEPARATE local removePlanTaskPrompt (not shared with worker-dispatch.ts) gained a second positional `agentName: string` parameter (not an opts field, since ResolveAndSpawnOptions has no per-call phase discriminator); a new `planPhaseAgentName(phase)` helper maps 'planner'->DEFAULT_PLANNER_AGENT / 'auditor'->DEFAULT_AUDITOR_AGENT for the 2 call sites that already carry a `phase: PlanDispatchPhase` parameter (runVerifiedPlanDispatch, emitPlanTimeoutTerminal), and the 2 call sites without one (runPlannerPollStep, the auditor poll tail in runPlanWorkerSequence) pass the matching DEFAULT_*_AGENT constant directly. Scope note for the next reviewer: the story's own description text named only 'worker-dispatch.ts's removeWorkerTaskPrompt chokepoint, or a path-returning seam on BackendAdapter' as the fix location, but CodexAdapter.buildSpawnArgv writes a codex instructions file for ALL FOUR actors uniformly (same writeCodexInstructionsFile call in its private renderActor), so planner/auditor were the same class of leak and were fixed too, per the merit-over-cost rule (a deferral would just reproduce this same finding one actor later). Proof is a delete-and-diff, not a tautological direct-call test: test/supervisor/codex-instructions-production-terminal.test.ts drives runSupervisor (implementer) and makeReviewDispatch (reviewer) end-to-end with a codex backend (codexAuthCheckFn/codexModelsCacheReaderFn bypassed, cwd staged with a project.toml + stub .claude/agents/<name>.md, TMPDIR redirected to a scratch root per GOTCHA 14/CAM-510's never-import-tmpdir-directly convention) and asserts the leaf directory (`cam-cli-codex-instructions/<agentName>/<pid>/`) is empty after the dispatch converges to a terminal ('complete' / '<review>CLEAN</review>'). Verified falsifiable: stashed all 4 src/ edits, re-ran the new test file, both tests failed with the expected leftover `.md` filename in the diff (proving the test drives the real code path, not a fake), then popped the stash and re-ran green. Did NOT add a symmetric production-terminal test for planner/auditor (plan-runner.ts) -- the fix there mirrors the implementer/reviewer fix exactly (same helper shape, same DEFAULT_*_AGENT threading) and the full suite (including plan-runner's own extensive dispatch-lifecycle test files) stayed green, but a future story could add one if a reviewer wants the same delete-and-diff proof for those two actors specifically. All gates green this dispatch: typecheck clean (bunx tsc --noEmit), full bun test 6093 pass / 0 fail (371 files, up from 6091/370 pre-story -- the 2 new tests), full bun run check:all spine green after raising 3 file-size ceilings (src/supervisor/loop.ts 2766->2778, src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts 2453->2474, src/supervisor/review.ts 884->887, each to the gate's own reported actual line count, with a dated US-R1-001/CAM-510 note prepended to file-size-budget.json's _ref and the file staged before the recheck, per the gate-discipline rubric). No vendor/templates changes, so embed-vendor:check ran clean as part of check:all with nothing to regenerate. scripts/cam/prd.json is modified in the working tree (new US-R1-00N review-round stories already appended by the prior review round) but deliberately left UNSTAGED/uncommitted by this story: prd.json passes:true writes and new-story appends are supervisor/reviewer-owned (mirrors the git log precedent -- feat commits never touch prd.json; 'chore(cam): finalize US-XXX (supervisor)' commits do).
